title: se implementation scratchpad - vale bridge capital
content:
Context:
- Customer: Vale Bridge Capital (mid-market hedge fund)
- Use-case: low-latency quant research assistant + private deployment for IP protection
- Deployment target: Private (VPC) with dedicated capacity for research cluster; initial scope: 3 model endpoints (embedding + two generative variants)
- SLA asks: 99.9% monthly uptime, burst capacity during EOD runs

Meeting notes (2025-01-20 sync w/ Vale Eng + Security):
- Vale security wants KMS integration + HSM for key ops, legal requested audit logs retention 2y
- Network: they'll provide a peered VPC; we need a static egress IP for vendor allowlist
- Data residency: primary in us-east-1, DR in eu-west-1
- Initial traffic profile: 100 req/s steady for embeddings; generation mostly interactive (p50 latency target < 200ms for small prompts)
- Integration team: Vale point: Maria Chen (infra)

Action items (priority order):
1) Configure Dedicated pool sizing for first month (estimate): 4 x A10G nodes for embeddings, 6 x A100s for generative variants. (todo: validate with infra cost)
2) Create private deployment plan doc + network diagram for Vale security review (due 2025-01-27).
3) KMS/HSM integration checklist + sample KMS policy (liaise with security).
4) Implement static egress IP solution and confirm with Vale allowlist.
5) Prepare canary rollout plan for model updates (A/B routing + auto-fallback to hosted small model).
6) Instrument eval prompt set for 50 representative customer prompts (Sofia to help).

Config notes / snippets:
- Model mapping:
  - embeddings: small-adam-v1 (quant 8-bit) -> endpoint: vale-emb-01
  - gen-lowlat: fast-chat-3b (v2) -> endpoint: vale-gen-lowlat-01 (pinned)
  - gen-highqual: llama-xl-like (quant 4-bit) -> endpoint: vale-gen-hq-01 (rolling updates)

- Recommended batch settings (initial):
  - embeddings: batch_size=256, max_wait_ms=50
  - gen-lowlat: batch_size=8, max_wait_ms=20, dynamic_kv_cache=true
  - gen-highqual: batch_size=16, max_wait_ms=80, use_prefetch=true

- Autoscale policy (draft):
  - metric: token_throughput
  - min_replicas: 2
  - target_util: 65%
  - scale_up_step: +2 nodes when sustained 90% for 5m
  - scale_down_delay: 10m stable under 50%

Network / infra checklist:
- [ ] Shared VPC peering established (ask Vale for VPC id + CIDR ranges)
- [ ] Static egress IP assigned (route through NAT gateway in redwood-managed subnet)
- [ ] Security group rules: open ports 443 only to Vale mgmt CIDRs; SSH restricted via bastion
- [ ] KMS key created (customer-managed) + test encrypt/decrypt flow
- [ ] Audit log pipeline -> S3 (retention policy 2y) and SIEM forward (Splunk)

Quick commands / terraform hints (for infra team):
- Grant KMS key: aws kms create-grant --key-id <key> --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::redwood:role/RedwoodPrivateRole --operations Encrypt Decrypt GenerateDataKey
- Static egress: terraform aws_nat_gateway + eip + route table association (one NAT per AZ for HA)

Open questions / risks:
- Encryption in motion: Vale insists on mTLS mutual auth for control plane — need pointer to mutual TLS cert rotation docs.
- Cost: Customer expects < $Xk/month committed for first 3 months; our Dedicated sizing may exceed — discuss with sales for reserved pricing.
- Model privacy guarantees: customer wants proof that prompt data never leaves their VPC; need to confirm endpoint-level isolation and KV cache eviction behavior on node reuse.

Testing / validation plan:
- Pre-prod: replicate customer traffic profile against staging stack (use k6 + tokenized workloads).
- Performance: run 24h perf run to validate p50/p95 latencies and throughput targets.
- Security: KMS end-to-end test, cert rotation test, audit logs ingestion verification.

Communication / playbook items:
- On major incident: automatic fallback to hosted small model in us-east-1 and notify Vale via configured webhook + SE war room channel.
- Runbook (outline): detect >5% error rate -> trigger canary rollback -> notify Vale -> open incident w/ SRE

Notes to self:
- Need sample network diagram template — check shared_drives/engineering/private-deployments/network-templates (ask Liam).
- Pull recent benchmark numbers for fast-chat-3b from serving-runtime folder (PRs from Dec 2024).
- Book follow-up w/ Vale security (Maria) for 2025-01-28 10am PST.

References / links:
- Confluence: Vale Bridge onboarding (conf-874)
- Jira: SE-4821 (private deploy runbook), VALE-12 (contract + legal asks)
- GH: infra-config PR 279 (static egress NAT module)

Recent changes log (quick):
- 2025-01-11: initial customer discovery notes added
- 2025-01-20: synced with Vale; added KMS + network asks
- 2025-02-10: updated autoscale draft after perf run; lowered target_util to 65%

Todo (short):
- [ ] Draft private deployment diagram (due 01/27)
- [ ] Share KMS policy example with Vale (Asha)
- [ ] Confirm static egress IP with infra (Liam)
- [ ] Create eval prompt set and baseline metrics (Sofia)
- [ ] Get sales to confirm reserved pricing proposal (Bryan)
